title: Add symbol and capsule expansion

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python-v1 symbol and capsule expansion capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse the current-head semantic_capsule projection rather than introduce a PCSM wrapper or a second symbol authority. compile_semantic_capsules deterministically projects authority-admitted graph symbols and related capsule kinds into a versioned CapsuleIndex, binds each capsule to node/source/root/authority/evidence/dependency identities, and supports bounded incremental recomputation with explicit invalidation paths. No source-map, graph, model, proof, storage, M2, or M3 authority is created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The reusable implementation and focused positive/negative contract tests are current-head and pass, but no canonical aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID or exact PCSM semantic graph/index is available to bind a concrete source-forest symbol/capsule expansion. This receipt therefore records capability only and does not invent capsule CIDs, a graph/index CID, a source-map CID, or a promoted result.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: The current-head semantic_capsule module already supplies the smallest Python-v1 authority-consumer for symbol and capsule expansion. A PCSM-named projection, alternate CID scheme, duplicate graph, or capsule-body store would compete with existing authorities and exceeds the exact declared-output boundary.

service.result: CapsuleCompileResult containing a deterministic CapsuleIndex, per-symbol SemanticCapsuleRecord values, reuse/invalidation/demotion evidence, and optional hermetic Datalog derivation

determinism_and_binding.identity: SemanticCapsuleRecord derives capsule_cid from canonical schema/kind/node/node-content/root/source-root/authority/trust/provenance/version/evidence/dependency/edge data. CapsuleIndex derives index_cid from exact graph_id and ordered capsule identities. Forged capsule or index identities are rejected during decoding/reverification.
determinism_and_binding.symbol_and_capsule_expansion: Only authority-admitted graph nodes project into capsules. Symbols project to the symbol capsule kind; connected required nodes project to contract/effect/policy/proof/test/environment/release kinds. Incremental recomputation uses explicit seed nodes, preserves unrelated capsule identities, supplies minimal explanation paths, demotes stale historical receipts, and refuses reuse with unknown required dependencies.
determinism_and_binding.bounds: The index has deterministic maximum capsule, Datalog-fact, and Datalog-iteration limits. Bounds and malformed, noncanonical, forged, unknown, or proposal-only data fail closed.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: SemanticDependencyGraph remains the sole graph/edge authority; datasets remains canonical semantic identity authority; ipfs_kit remains exact-byte/CID storage authority. The selected projection does not embed raw repository source, rebuild graph authority, promote a local symbol alias to canonical identity, accept model output as evidence, or authorize proof/completion/M2/M3 mutation.

positive_coverage: Symbol and connected semantic nodes project to deterministic, content-addressed capsules and indexes independent of input order.

Incremental update equals clean rebuild; source/environment identities participate; explicit seeded symbol changes invalidate downstream proof/test/release capsules while unrelated capsules remain reusable.
Every reuse/invalidation path is minimal; stale historical receipts demote; hermetic Datalog derivation and canonical round-trip verification succeed.
negative_coverage: Proposal-only annotations never become capsules and the capsule layer cannot rebuild graph authority or embed raw source.
Forged capsule CID/schema, unknown mandatory dependencies, and requests to compile an unknown node fail closed.
focused_capsule_validation.scope_limit: The graph is a controlled fixture, so this proves contract behavior only. It is not evidence of an exact current-PCSM source-forest expansion, a PCSM source-map identity, or promotion.
